check: V1a partial correlation formula
what is compared: P_ij = -Theta_ij / sqrt(Theta_ii Theta_jj) against the partial correlation computed from the covariance (Schur complement), all 300 pairs

check: V1b zero in Theta means conditional independence
what is compared: partial correlation of every pair with Theta_ij = 0, computed independently from the covariance

check: V1c partial correlation in samples
what is compared: formula against correlation of regression residuals on 300000 samples (60 pairs)

check: V2a Theta update solves the stationarity equation
what is compared: gradient of the relaxed objective, -Theta^-1 + S + lambda (Theta - Z), at the closed form Theta (20 random cases)

check: V2b Theta update is positive definite
what is compared: smallest eigenvalue of Theta over 20 random cases

check: V2c Theta update is a minimum
what is compared: objective after a small random move minus objective at Theta, worst case

check: V3a matrix square root forward
what is compared: eigendecomposition square root against scipy.linalg.sqrtm

check: V3b matrix square root backward
what is compared: hand written gradient against finite differences (torch gradcheck)

check: V4a AM never increases its objective
what is compared: relaxed objective after every AM iteration (1500 iterations, lambda 0.5, 2, 8). Each step is an exact minimization over one block, so it cannot go up

check: V4b AM fixed point is the true minimizer
what is compared: Theta from AM after 3000 iterations against the minimizer of the same objective found by an independent optimizer (L-BFGS)

check: V4c speed of AM with fixed settings (reported, no threshold)
what is compared: relative gap of the AM objective to its final value on a D = 25 problem at the scale used in the experiments (rho 0.01, lambda 5)
note: uGLAD uses 15 learned steps, so it does not follow this path

check: V5a every Theta step is positive definite
what is compared: smallest eigenvalue of Theta_k over the 15 unrolled steps

check: V5b output is symmetric
what is compared: max |Z - Z^T|

check: V5c parameter count does not depend on D
what is compared: learnable parameters of the network, built for D = 10, 25, 100

check: V5d training reduces the loss
what is compared: training loss in the first and the last epoch of the selected fold

check: V6a conditional mean given all other variables
what is compared: -Theta_ij / Theta_ii against regression coefficients from 400000 samples

check: V6b conditional variance given all other variables
what is compared: 1 / Theta_ii against the residual variance of that regression

check: V6c conditional given a subset of variables
what is compared: mean and covariance of X_0, X_1 given X_2..X_5, with the other variables integrated out, against regression on samples

check: V6d marginal
what is compared: Sigma[0:3, 0:3] against the sample covariance of X_0..X_2

check: V6e factorization into node and edge factors
what is compared: sum of node and edge log factors minus the exact log density, for 50 random points (must be one constant)

check: V6f local Markov property
what is compared: prediction of a variable from its neighbours only against prediction from all other variables (200 samples, 25 variables)

check: V7a moralization
what is compared: collider adds an edge between the parents, chain does not, for both the DAG and the CPDAG converters

check: V7b metrics on a hand worked example
what is compared: SHD, precision, F1 and perfect-ranking AUC and AUPR against values worked out by hand
